issues.what: Explanation incorrectly claims applications cannot choose exit code 137
issues.detail: An application CAN voluntarily call exit(137). The 128+signal convention is set by the shell/kernel but nothing prevents a program from using exit(137).
issues.suggestion: Change to: 'While an application could technically call exit(137), this exit code conventionally indicates SIGKILL (128+9)'.
